description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.
> The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or on the minute.
The number of entries to return.

description.zh:
服务地域。取值：
- **cn**：中国内地。
- **cn-hongkong**：非中国内地。
description.en:
The region of the service. Valid values:
- **cn**: the Chinese mainland.
- **cn-hongkong**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or on the minute.

title.en: Query top HTTP methods for a website

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-top-http-method --biz-region cn --domain example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 1712449710 --end-time 1722339300 --limit 20 --query-type example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
